title: Plant Manager
text:
Permian Enterprises Ltd. is seeking an experienced, results-driven **Plant Manager** to oversee daily plant operations and lead our production team. The Plant Manager is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and cost-effective operations while consistently meeting production goals, maintaining quality standards, and delivering excellent customer service.

This individual will provide strong leadership, establish operational priorities, develop employees, and ensure all plant activities align with company policies, procedures, and performance expectations. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with strong decision-making skills, a commitment to workplace safety, and the ability to build a productive, accountable, and positive team culture.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

**Plant Operations & Production**

* Oversee and coordinate all daily plant operations to ensure production goals and deadlines are consistently met.
* Establish production schedules, determine priorities, and allocate resources to maximize operational efficiency.
* Monitor production performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement solutions to increase productivity.
* Ensure all work is completed in accordance with established quality standards, customer specifications, and company procedures.
* Coordinate activities across departments and multiple operational entities to maintain smooth and efficient workflows.
* Manage equipment, materials, labor, and other resources effectively.

**Leadership & Employee Management**

* Provide direction, supervision, and support to plant employees and supervisory personnel.
* Assign responsibilities, delegate tasks, and establish clear performance expectations.
* Hold employees accountable for performance, attendance, productivity, and adherence to company policies.
* Address employee concerns and workplace issues professionally, consistently, and in a timely manner.
* Develop and maintain a positive workplace culture built on teamwork, communication, respect, and accountability.
* Identify training needs and support employee development and growth.

**Safety & Quality Control**

* Promote a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with all company safety policies and procedures.
* Ensure employees are properly trained and follow required safety practices.
* Monitor quality control processes to ensure products and services meet company and customer expectations.
* Identify operational risks, address safety concerns, and take corrective action when necessary.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and professional plant environment.

**Communication & Performance**

* Communicate effectively with upper management, supervisors, employees, and customers as needed.
* Provide regular updates regarding production performance, staffing, operational challenges, and improvement opportunities.
* Make timely decisions and resolve operational issues with sound judgment.
* Balance multiple priorities while maintaining focus on company objectives and deadlines.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Minimum of **2 years of management experience** in an oilfield plant or production plant environment preferred.
* Experience with coating and sandblasting operations preferred.
* Strong leadership and employee management skills, with demonstrated experience handling employee relations and maintaining a positive workplace culture.
* Excellent critical-thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to interpret complex situations and communicate expectations and solutions effectively.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask, prioritize, and delegate responsibilities.
* Self-motivated, dependable, and capable of working independently with limited oversight.
* Proficient in English, including reading and writing.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.
* Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record required.

**Compensation & Benefits**

**Salary:** Up to $115,000 per year, based on qualifications and experience.

**Required Experience**

* Production Plant Management: Minimum 2 years
* Oilfield Management: Minimum 2 years

**Language**

* English: Required
* Spanish: Preferred

**Work Environment**

* Full-time, in-person position.
* Requires a hands-on leadership presence within the plant and the ability to oversee daily operational activities.

**Permian Enterprises Ltd. is committed to maintaining a safe, productive, and respectful workplace while delivering quality service to our customers.**

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: Up to $115,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* production plant management: 2 years (Required)
* oilfield management: 2 years (Required)

Language:

* Spanish (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
